title: K-Drama Filming Locations in Seoul: Where to Visit in 2026
description: Walk the streets where your favorite K-dramas were filmed. A complete guide to iconic Seoul filming locations with addresses and tips.
content:
Part of what makes K-dramas so captivating is the way they capture Seoul — both its gleaming modernity and its hidden historic corners. Good news: most of these locations are real, accessible, and waiting for you to visit.

Bukchon Hanok Village

Featured in: "Goblin," "My Love from the Star," "Crash Landing on You" (flashback scenes)

The narrow lanes between traditional hanok houses have appeared in dozens of dramas. The most photographed spot is the Bukchon Eight Views — particularly the view down Gahoe-ro 11-gil. Go at dawn before the crowds arrive.

📍 Address: Gahoe-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul | Metro: Anguk Station, Line 3

Gyeongbokgung Palace

Featured in: "Mr. Sunshine," "The Last Empress," "My Country"

Korea's most impressive royal palace has served as backdrop for countless historical dramas. The north gate area (Sinmumun) is particularly popular with film crews.

📍 Address: 161 Sajik-ro, Jongno-gu | Metro: Gyeongbokgung Station, Line 3

Hongdae & Yeonnam-dong

Featured in: "Our Beloved Summer," "Twenty-Five Twenty-One," "Start-Up"

The youthful energy of Hongdae translates perfectly to coming-of-age dramas. The Gyeongui Line Forest Park (연트럴파크) has appeared in countless romantic scenes.

💡 Insider Tip: Many dramas film at Ewha Womans University campus. The main gate and amphitheater are accessible to visitors and look exactly like on screen.

N Seoul Tower (Namsan Tower)

Featured in: "You Who Came from the Stars," "Boys Over Flowers," "Secret Garden"

The iconic love lock fence at the tower's observation deck is a pilgrimage site for drama fans. Cable car to the top runs daily from 10AM.

Hangang River Parks

Featured in: Almost every Seoul-set drama ever made

The riverside parks (Banpo, Yeouido, Ttukseom) appear constantly in Korean drama. The Banpo Bridge Rainbow Fountain is particularly dramatic at night.
